headline: LAD @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.80 at MIN 3.81, with a projected total of 8.61. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (LAD -0.36, MIN -0.49), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.84, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Shohei Ohtani has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Byron Buxton, Josh Bell, Mookie Betts, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tristan Gray because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
